svg.title: The link of a result
svg.desc: The entry of document 412 carries the ID of its file and its path in the folders of the user. When the iOS app searches, its link is nextcloud://open-file with the user and the link /f/412. Otherwise its link is /f/412, which a browser opens in Nextcloud's viewer; the Android app opens the file in its own viewer by the ID and the path.
